businesses.business: Life science instruments and quality control products

offering_description.value: Mesa Laboratories makes sterilization and cleaning indicators for healthcare facilities and regulated manufacturers. It also makes genetic analysis, biopharmaceutical research and calibration instruments and supplies for laboratories and manufacturers. It sells directly and through distributors and provides laboratory testing, calibration and instrument servicing.

primary_products.value: sterilization and cleaning indicators; genetic analysis instruments and assay kits; automated immunoassay systems and reagents; peptide synthesis instruments; calibration and monitoring instruments

primary_services.value: sterilization efficacy testing; instrument calibration; instrument repair and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, dental practices, pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, clinical and research laboratories, and industrial quality teams

end_markets.value: healthcare; pharmaceuticals and biotechnology; medical device manufacturing; molecular diagnostics and genomics research; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments and recurring purchases of indicators, assay kits, reagents and other consumables; service fees: laboratory testing, instrument calibration, repair and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: uses biological materials, reagents and instrument components to make consumables and equipment for healthcare, laboratory and industrial customers; service provider: tests sterilization samples and calibrates or repairs instruments for healthcare facilities, laboratories and manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: sterilization and disinfection control, clinical genomics, biopharmaceutical development, and calibration and monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales teams serving healthcare facilities, laboratories and manufacturers; distributors / dealers: specialty laboratory and quality control distributors in domestic and international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA medical device requirements apply to certain sterilization indicators and diagnostic products

notes: The current relative scale of the business lines is uncertain.
